# OpenOdia

> openodia is an open source Python library and command-line tool for Odia (ଓଡ଼ିଆ) text: tokenize, normalize, clean, translate, detect language, generate names, summarize, remove stopwords, n-grams and word frequency. Install with `pip install openodia` or run `uvx openodia`.

Version note: `--json` on every CLI subcommand (one machine-readable JSON document on stdout) needs a release newer than 0.1.14. PyPI 0.1.14 has `--json` on `detect-language` only, and other subcommands exit with code 2 there. From a source checkout, `uv run openodia <subcommand> --json` works.

## Docs

- [Documentation](https://openodia.soumendrak.com/): install, library API and command-line interface
- [Applications](https://openodia.soumendrak.com/application/): worked examples such as name generation and data masking

## For agents

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/soumendrak/openodia/blob/main/AGENTS.md): CLI examples, JSON output shapes, exit codes and development commands
- [SKILL.md](https://github.com/soumendrak/openodia/blob/main/skills/openodia/SKILL.md): agent skill for the openodia CLI
